goal: Find the cheapest available one-way flight for one adult in economy from São Paulo, Brazil (SAO, all São Paulo airports) to Iceland, departing on any date from October 1 through October 31, 2026 inclusive. Compare fares across the whole month using the fare calendar or price graph; do not just use the initially selected date. Choose the lowest-priced date found and show its flight results ordered by cheapest, in Brazilian reais (BRL). Iceland destinations may include Keflavík/Reykjavík. Stop when the cheapest matching flight options and their departure date are visible. Do not select a flight for booking, book, or purchase anything.
verify: const origin = fields.some(a => a.label.trim().startsWith('Where from?') && /São Paulo|Sao Paulo|Guarulhos|Congonhas|Viracopos|SAO|GRU|CGH|VCP/i.test(a.value || ''));
const oneWay = page.actions.some(a => a.label.includes('Change ticket type') && a.value === 'One way');
